topic: Higher Order Derivatives: The Dynamics of Motion

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Running Cheetah
lecture_lines: Cheetahs show us changing motion clearly.
Velocity is the derivative of position.
Acceleration is the derivative of velocity.
Rates of change build a chain.
animations: Create a cheetah icon (#FF8C00) in the center.
Show the cheetah accelerating forward to the right.
Display velocity vector arrow (#00FFFF) appearing above cheetah.
Fade in acceleration vector arrow (#FFFF00) above cheetah.
Flash velocity and acceleration vectors to emphasize difference.
